==English==

===Etymology===
{{etymon|en|:bor|fr:attaque|tree=1}}
{{bor+|en|fr|attaque}}, derived from the verb {{m|fr|attaquer}}, from {{der|en|it|attaccare|t=to join, attach}} (used in {{m|it||attaccare battaglia|t=to join battle}}), from {{der|en|frk|*stakkijan|t=to stick, stick to, attach}}. {{doublet|en|attach}}. Displaced native {{ncog|enm|onresen}}, from {{ncog|ang|onrǣsan|t=to attack}}; and {{ncog|enm|resinge|t=an assault, attack}} (compare {{m+|ang|onrǣs|t=an attack}}).

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/əˈtæk/|a=RP,GA,AU}}
** {{audio|en|En-us-attack.ogg|a=GA}}
** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Naomi Persephone Amethyst (NaomiAmethyst)-attack.wav|a=GA}}

* {{IPA|en|/əˈtak/|a=SSB,Northern England,Scotland,Wales}}
* {{IPA|en|/əˈtɛk/|a=NZ}}
* {{rhymes|en|æk|s=2}}
* {{hyph|en|at|tack}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# An [[attempt]] to cause [[damage]], [[injury]] to, or [[death]] of an opponent or enemy.
#* {{quote-book|en|title=The Book of Sharks|author={{w|Richard Ellis (biologist)|Richard Ellis}}|year=1983|publisher=Knopf|ISBN=0679722106|passage=From 1906 to 1960, there were forty-six recorded shark '''attacks''', half of which were fatal.|page=161}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|date=2013-07-19|author=[http://www.theguardian.com/profile/marktran Mark Tran]
|volume=189|issue=6|page=1|magazine=w:The Guardian Weekly
|title=[http://www.theguardian.com/global-development/2013/jul/12/war-denying-children-education Denied an education by war]
|passage=One particularly damaging, but often ignored, effect of conflict on education is the proliferation of '''attacks''' on schools{{...}}as children, teachers or school buildings become the targets of '''attacks'''. Parents fear sending their children to school. Girls are particularly vulnerable to sexual violence.}}
## {{lb|en|gaming}} Any of several specific maneuvers, skills, or special abilities that a character can use to inflict damage against opponents.
##* {{quote-web|en|year=2002|month=March|author=Aaron Butler|title=Mimesis Online (PC)|work=GameSpy.com|url=http://www.gamespy.com/reviews/march02/mimesisonline/|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20021216225820/http://www.gamespy.com/reviews/march02/mimesisonline/|archivedate=2002-12-16
|passage=Combat in ''Mimesis Online'' is nice and simple. You click on your target {{...}} and then keep right-clicking your chosen '''attack''' from the drop down menu. Every time you right click on the '''attack''', your character will swing, shoot, etc.}}
##* {{quote-web|en|date=2022-01-28|author=Chris Tapsell|title=Pokémon Legends Arceus Kleavor boss fight: How to beat Kleavor|work=Eurogamer.ner|url=https://www.eurogamer.net/pokemon-legends-arceus-kleavor-boss-fight-how-to-beat-kleavor-8039
|passage=Kleavor has several '''attacks''' that it's worth roughly memorising: a charge '''attack''', where it runs at you quickly; a jump '''attack''', that causes a pillar of rock to spike out from under the ground; and a spin '''attack''' that does damage in a circle around it.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20260202152057/https://www.eurogamer.net/pokemon-legends-arceus-kleavor-boss-fight-how-to-beat-kleavor-8039|archivedate=2 February 2026}}
# An attempt to [[detract]] from the [[worth]] or [[credibility]] of, a person, position, idea, object, or thing, by [[physical]], [[verbal]], [[emotional]], or other [[assault]].
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1913|author=[[w:Robert Barr (writer)|Robert Barr]]
|title=Lord Stranleigh Abroad
|chapter=4|url=http://openlibrary.org/works/OL1796924W
|passage=“I came down like a wolf on the fold, didn’t I ?  Why didn’t I telephone ?  Strategy, my dear boy, strategy. This is a surprise '''attack''', and I’d no wish that the garrison, forewarned, should escape. …”}}
#: {{ux|en|They claimed the censorship of the article was an '''attack''' on free speech.}}
# A time in which one attacks; the [[offence]] of a [[battle]].
#: {{ux|en|The army timed their '''attack''' to coincide with the local celebrations.}}
# {{lb|en|informal|by extension}} The beginning of active operations on anything.
#: {{ux|en|Having washed the plates from dinner, I made an '''attack''' on the laundry.}}
# {{senseid|en|Q4071928}}{{lb|en|computing}} An attempt to [[exploit]] a [[vulnerability]] in a computer system.
#: ''[[birthday attack]]; [[denial-of-service attack]]''
# {{lb|en|cricket}} [[collectively|Collectively]], the [[bowler]]s of a [[cricket]] [[side]].
# {{lb|en|volleyball}} Any contact with the ball other than a [[serve]] or [[block]] which sends the ball across the [[plane]] of the net.
#: {{syn|en|hit|spike}}
# {{lb|en|lacrosse}} The three [[attackmen]] on the field or all the attackmen of a team.
# {{lb|en|medicine}} The sudden [[onset]] of a [[disease]] or [[condition]].
#: {{ux|en|I've had an '''attack''' of the flu.}}
# An active episode of a chronic or recurrent disease.
# {{lb|en|music}} The [[onset]] of a musical note, particularly with respect to the strength (and duration) of that onset.
#: {{ant|en|decay|release}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2004|author=Gary Giddins|title=Weather Bird: Jazz at the Dawn of Its Second Century|page=322
|passage=Eric Reed was a curious choice as pianist, since his busy Petersonian '''attack''' is the antithesis of Lewis's, but he acquitted himself with panache, {{...}}}}
# {{lb|en|acoustics}} The [[amount]] of time taken for the [[volume]] of an [[audio]] [[signal]] to go from zero to maximum level (e.g. an audio waveform representing a [[snare]] drum hit would feature a very fast attack, whereas that of a wave [[wash]]ing to shore would feature a slow attack).
# {{lb|en|oenology}} The [[initial]] [[sensory]] [[impact]] of a [[wine]].
# {{lb|en|South India}} {{short for|en|heart attack}}.

===Verb===
{{en-verb|+|+|+,~t<l:obsolete>,~ted<l:obsolete,dialectal>}}

# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[apply]] [[violent]] [[force]] to someone or something.
#: {{syn|en|savage}}
#: {{ux|en|This species of snake will only '''attack''' humans if it feels threatened.}}
#* {{quote-av|en|date=December 8 1941|author=President {{w|Franklin D. Roosevelt}}|title={{w|Day of Infamy speech|Day of Infamy Speech}}|url=https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Roosevelt_Infamy.ogg|location=Washington, D.C.|time=0:00|page=1|pageurl=https://www.archives.gov/files/publications/prologue/images/day-of-infamy-draft1-page1.jpg|passage=Yesterday, December seventh, 1941, a date which will live in infamy, the United States of America was suddenly and deliberately '''attacked''' by naval and air forces of the Empire of Japan.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[aggressive]]ly [[challenge]] a person, idea, etc., with words (''particularly in newspaper headlines, because it typesets into less space than "criticize" or similar'').
#: {{ux|en|She published an article '''attacking''' the recent pay cuts.}}
#* {{quote-journal
|1=en
|date=June 3, 2012
|author=Nathan Rabin
|journal=w:The A.V. Club
|publisher=w:Fusion Media Group
|title=TV: Review: THE SIMPSONS (CLASSIC): “Mr. Plow” (season 4, episode 9; originally aired 11/19/1992)
|url=http://www.avclub.com/articles/mr-plow,75560/
|passage=In its God-like prime, The Simpsons '''attacked''' well-worn satirical fodder from unexpected angles, finding fresh laughs in the hoariest of subjects.
|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20121026042752/http://www.avclub.com/articles/mr-plow,75560/
|archivedate=26 October 2012}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To begin to affect; to act upon injuriously or destructively; to begin to decompose or waste.
#* {{RQ:Macaulay History of England|chapter=25|passage=On the fourth of March he was '''attacked''' by fever.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1866|author=w:Balfour Stewart|title=An Elementary Treatise on Heat
|passage=Hydrofluoric acid {{...}} '''attacks''' the glass.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[deal with]] something in a direct way; to set to work upon.
#: {{ux|en|We’ll have dinner before we '''attack''' the biology homework.}}
#: {{ux|en|I '''attacked''' the meal with a hearty appetite.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive|cricket}} To [[aim]] balls at the [[batsman]]’s [[wicket]].
# {{lb|en|intransitive|cricket}} To [[set]] a [[field]], or [[bowl]] in a [[manner]] [[design]]ed to get wickets.
# {{lb|en|intransitive|cricket}} To [[bat]] [[aggressive]]ly, so as to [[score]] [[run]]s [[quick]]ly.
# {{lb|en|soccer}} To move forward in an active attempt to score a point, as opposed to trying not to concede.
# {{lb|en|cycling}} To [[accelerate]] quickly in an attempt to get ahead of the other [[rider]]s.
# {{lb|en|physical chemistry}} (Of a chemical species) To approach a chemical species or bond in order to form a bond with it.
